domain_restrictions: the cardinality of S is at most r
each element k of S is a positive integer (so 1/k is well-defined)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every positive integer n, for every integer r with 1 <= r <= n, for every subset S of {1,2,...,n} with size at most r, the sum of 1/k over all k in S is at most the harmonic number H_r.

variables.name: n
variables.role: global parameter defining the ambient set {1,...,n}

variables.name: r
variables.role: upper bound on the size of S and index for H_r

variables.name: S
variables.role: index set for the partial harmonic sum over reciprocals

variables.name: k
variables.role: summation index in sum over k in S of 1/k

witness_dependencies: no existential witnesses appear; the claim is purely universal with an inequality conclusion

statement_nl: If r is an integer with 1 <= r <= n and S is a subset of {1,...,n} with |S| <= r, then sum_{k in S} 1/k <= H_r.
